subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “You are important to me even when my memory is not good.'”?
options: Amy laughed and said it was fine.
People laughed, and the room became calmer.
When the mistake was discovered, everyone laughed.
Her friend laughed when she read it.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Amy laughed and said it was fine.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「People laughed, and the room became calmer.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「When the mistake was discovered, everyone laughed.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「You are important to me even when my memory is not good.' Her friend laughed when she read it.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「You are important to me even when my memory is not good.' Her friend laughed when she read it.」，答案為「Her friend laughed when she read it.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Her friend laughed when she read it.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
